verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents an open-source benchmarking tool for testing throughput and latency under various load conditions and comparing deployment configurations, which is a load-testing guide. It also publishes a speed target: Fast variants aim for 100+ tokens per second. Missing for 10: per-model published tokens-per-second/latency tables or benchmark results, depth of the benchmarking guide beyond summary lines, independent or hands-on corroboration of speed claims.
